item.title: Local windsurfing stars Jaeger Stone and Sarah Kenyon take top gongs at Margaret River Wave Classic
item.description: Geraldton’s top windsurfers prevailed in a showdown on the waves at the Margaret River Classic, with reigning junior girls world champion Sarah Kenyon and local legend Jaegar Stone claiming category titles.

item.title: Double exhibition featuring Indigenous artists opening at Geraldton Regional Art Gallery this weekend
item.description: Two “underrated” mediums will take centrestage in dual exhibitions opening this weekend at the Geraldton Regional Art Gallery, including one of the most significant private art collections in Australia.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Nearby station owner questions police knowledge, communication in Mullewa gunman manhunt
item.description: The owner of a Mid West station near where a man fled from after allegedly shooting his partner in the hand, says the community is not on edge but has questioned police knowledge and communication.

item.title: Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League round 12: Sportsmans out to reclaim winning edge after upset loss to CVN
item.description: Sportsmans will be keen to shake off a disappointing loss last weekend, but it won’t be easy as they face a charging Wanderers on Saturday in the Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League.

item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: For a tennis tragic like me, attending the Australian Open is simply heaven
item.description: I just love the game of tennis and attending the Australian Open is the equivalent of tennis heaven. That’s what I did recently with a couple of my very good friends.

item.title: Four of 30 new turbines at Warradarge wind farm in the Mid West installed, construction to be finished in 2027
item.description: Construction is gathering momentum at the Warradarge wind farm in the Mid West, with four of 30 extra wind turbines erected.

item.title: Geraldton speedster Jaeger Berry takes back-to-back WA Junior Formula 125 title in nail-biting final lap dash
item.description: Geraldton 14-year-old Jaeger Berry successfully defended his Formula 125 Junior State Title in a dramatic final-lap feature race shoot-out last weekend.

item.title: Nationals host forum in Geraldton to give a voice to fishers affected by demersal ban
item.description: Geraldton fishers are making their voices heard about the controversial demersal fishing ban at a forum held at Towns Football Club on Thursday.

item.title: Geraldton fishers air their grievances at Nationals WA-hosted forum about demersal fishing ban
item.description: No warning, no communication and no transparency were the common complaints at a Geraldton forum on Thursday as the backlash over the State Government’s fishing bans continues to deepen.

item.title: Confusion persists for demersal commercial fishers in wake of act of grace payments
item.description: Confusion around the demersal fishing ban continues more than a month on from the commercial closure, as fishers are uncertain about what compensation they will receive.
